founder.name: Dr. Nagappa Siddgonde
founder.role: Assistant Professor, Dept. of AE IIT Madras
founder.bio: Dr.Siddgonde leads the ACMS Laboratory at IIT Madras. His research focuses on advanced and sustainable composite materials, manufacturing, experimental mechanics, and multiscale materials modelling, aiming to bridge microstructural characteristics, material behaviour, and structural performance for next-generation aerospace and defence applications.
